player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''RexBanner7''') posted a [[Light]] [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]] list on DeckTech in September 2001.

notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Mind What You Have Learned, Dagobah, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Draw Their Fire and Boonta Eve Podrace; these count toward the 60. I Did It! is posted under 'Other'.

Posted 'All the Dagobah Sites' expanded to the five Light Dagobah sites printed by then (Bog Clearing, Jungle, Swamp, Training Area, Yoda's Hut; Dagobah: Cave is Dark), which brings the list to exactly 60.

Posted 'AFA x5' dested Anger, Fear, Aggression (Light Dagobah Effect); 'EPP Luke' and 'EPP Obi' dested Luke With Lightsaber and Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'YT-Transport' dested YT-1300 Transport; 'Honor' dested Honor Of The Jedi; 'Brisky Morning' dested Brisky Morning Munchen; 'Tatooine Race Arena' dested Tatooine: Podrace Arena; 'OOC/TT' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated.

Kept 'The Signal x3' as listed; the author's in-post Deck Edit says these three should be We Wish To Board At Once. A second Deck Edit suggests swapping Demotion, Landing Claw and the YT-1300 Transport for Yoda, Daughter and Test 1 (optional, not applied).
The strategy says the deck went 9-0 in tournament play, 4-0 of it at the Montreal DPC; the wiki has no page for that event, so the deck stays general.
